claims.statement: For every ordinary-tree isomorphism class on 16 vertices at p=7 satisfying x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1, the complete sum over original leaves v with Delta_7(T-v)<0 of Delta_6(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_6(T-N_T[s_v]) is strictly negative. The exact census generated 19,320 classes, of which 1,696 satisfy the guards; all eligible sums lie from -1,759 through -906.
claims.scope: Retained only as a bounded finite result at order 16 and rank 7. The route's registered universal assertion for all ordinary trees and all p with |T|=2p+2 remains open.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: the finite result was independently replayed from scratch-local copies of the route program and its pinned dependencies; its complete replay JSON equals the route result exactly. The generator boundary, strict terminal-inclusive first-descent scan, both eligibility guards, strict selector on each original leaf deletion, original H/R deletion sets, repeated-support multiplicity, every selected summand, and the complete sum were checked. The result supports only order 16 at p=7 and supplies no proof for other shell ranks, so the universal statement is not resolved.

limitations: The exact replay covers only order 16 at p=7 and the 1,696 eligible isomorphism classes at that order.
The universal first-order-shell assertion remains open; finite enumeration cannot establish it for other orders or ranks.
The replay uses source-pinned generator and evaluator copies and is not a formal proof or a separately implemented generator.
The permitted order-252 shell control was inspected but not replayed and is not used as evidence.
